audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart gave Ryze rows 5-6 and Skill rows 3-4 while the content layer, the packet chart, and every why on both layers say Pantheon at all seven stages (56.77% over 310 games).
audit.why: Ryze's mana/item breakpoints never overturn the lane per the data; the full whys for rows 3-6 already describe Pantheon winning, so the sides were the stale half.
audit.corrected: Full sides moved to all-Pantheon to agree with content win[] — see chart edits.

audit.why: Spikes accurate: L2 all-in before his mana works, L3-5 dive window, 6 Realm Warp is utility not a duel tool, first item still Pantheon's. His Tear/Seraph breakpoints acknowledged as the thing you outrun.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rune Prison labeled (E) in spikes[0] — it is his W; 'all-in whenever his E is down' in mid and spikes[1] pointed at Spell Flux (3.5s CD, never meaningfully down) instead of the W root; cooldowns field had no digits; dos/donts bodies were pasted trade lines.
audit.why: Kit: W Rune Prison 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s (slow, root with Flux — the one spell that cancels Pantheon's E channel and stops his W engage), Q Overload 5s, E Spell Flux 3.5s, R Realm Warp 180s utility teleport.

edits.before: W the step-up, empowered-Q the stun, E the answer, walk — the full toll he paid for one last-hit.
edits.after: At 2 he's mana-starved with a 5s Q as his only answer — W the first step-up and the trade is free.

edits.before: Spending the all-in into a held escape at even HP — Pantheon trades are loans; defaulting on one funds his whole comeback.
edits.after: Post-Tear he chips from 1000 range with 5-second Overloads — walk into his range only in the window after his W root is spent.

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison (Root): matchup-defining — Point-blank root — respect the EQ chain that follows it. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Aegis Assault for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Rune Prison cycles every 11s at rank 1 — the root chains into EQ and cancels your E channel; step up on its downtime. - His Q is 5s and Spell Flux 3.5s: the poke never stops, but the kill window does. - Budget your E (22s) around his W.

edits.before: Ryze is one of the clunkiest early laners in the game and you punish it hard: your level-2 W-Q all-in lands before he has the mana, cooldowns, or Rune Prison (E) chains to fight back. Aegis Assault soaks his Overload (Q) poke so his only pre-6 harass does nothing, and every time he steps to CS you Shield Vault in and stack Mortal Will. Shove and dive the moment he's low — he has no escape until much later.
edits.after: Ryze is one of the clunkiest early laners in the game and you punish it hard: your level-2 W-Q all-in lands before he has the mana, cooldowns, or Rune Prison (W) chains to fight back. Aegis Assault soaks his Overload (Q) poke so his only pre-6 harass does nothing, and every time he steps to CS you Shield Vault in and stack Mortal Will. Shove and dive the moment he's low — he has no escape until much later.

edits.before: Grand Starfall lets you collapse on him or answer a roam, while Ryze's ult (Realm Warp) is a utility teleport, not a fight tool — it does nothing for him in a 1v1. Keep the wave shoving so he can't freely stack Overload procs, and threaten all-ins whenever his E is on cooldown; he simply can't survive your W-Q-E burst this early.

edits.before: Through 4-6 nothing changes in his favour: Realm Warp is a utility ult, not a duel tool, so his 1v1 stays helpless. Keep the wave shoving to deny Overload procs, hold Aegis for his Rune Prison-Overload combo, and all-in whenever his E is down.
edits.after: Through 4-6 nothing changes in his favour: Realm Warp is a utility ult, not a duel tool, so his 1v1 stays helpless. Keep the wave shoving to deny Overload procs, hold Aegis for his Rune Prison-Overload combo, and all-in whenever his W is down.

edits.before: Two items into a fed Pantheon means you delete Ryze the instant you land Shield Vault: he's a immobile control mage and Aegis Assault eats the front-loaded Q-E combo he needs to root and burst. Build lethality, flank with Grand Starfall, and remove him from every fight before his scaling ever gets to matter.
